text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—And so!! I'll do anything!! Just say the 
word, Gim-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Is that your offering to me, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to give you the coolest birthday 
present in the world, Senpai— so I've been 
thinking about it this whole time..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still!! No matter what I came up with, I 
just kept thinking, "Gimlet-senpai's idea 
is way cooler!"...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I figured we should just go ahead and 
ask Gym-senpai, the coolest in the world, 
what she wants!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you did say 'anything,' right? 
There's only one thing I desire—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Stay true to your own aesthetics, Vodka!! 
Fulfill your conviction of becoming the 
'coolest' Umamusume in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you sprint to surpass even 
myself— that sight alone is the supreme 
vintage that sets my very soul ablaze—!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even the "things you want" are way too 
cool—?! Alright, a cool Umamusume never 
goes back on her word!! I'll definitely 
become one, no matter what!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—But asking for that on the spot today is 
impossible, so if there's anything I can 
give you right now, just name it!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, sounds good... How about we toast 
with some of your home-cooked food and 
freshly brewed barley tea?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, cooking and barley tea...!? Are you 
sure you're okay with that? It could be 
anything, literally anything, you know!?
